coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 1 of 6 ground-truth variable items (17%): the architecture comparison between original time-attention SiT and non-causal Hyena SiT. Generic training controls and autocorrelation metrics do not match the specified experimental setup and molecular measurements.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Substitutes synthetic signals and Lorenz-63 for the pentapeptide MDGEN dataset with 100k-frame, 10 ns trajectories. Does not use the training setup specified in Tables 2 and 4 or the 100 fs–100 ps lag range. Replaces torsional autocorrelation agreement with generic signal metrics and omits dynamical content defined as the negative derivative of autocorrelation with respect to log-timescale.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected conclusion that Hyena-augmented SiT generates extremely long trajectories matching MD autocorrelations across timescales and captures both fast oscillations and slow relaxations, supporting consistent, physically plausible molecular simulations.
